Package index

Overview

What the package is for, the order the steps happen in, and what it refuses to do quietly.

mysterymodel mysterymodel-package
mysterymodel: Opinionated Workflow for Clinical Prediction Models

Specify

What is being predicted, from which columns, and how the data divides. Written down and checked before anything is fitted.

mm_project()
Create a validated analysis configuration

Prepare

Eligibility with a ledger that reconciles, and a description that carries its denominators.

mm_clean()
Apply eligibility rules and account for every row that leaves
mm_eda()
Describe the cohort, with denominators and missingness

Fit and predict

The model, and risks from exactly that model.

mm_model()
Fit the declared model with rms
mm_predict()
Predict risk from exactly the fitted model

Assess the shape

What a declared modelling decision amounts to: the degrees of freedom a continuous predictor is given, and the evidence for a prespecified interaction. Both report and decide nothing.

mm_splines()
Draw each continuous predictor as a straight line and as a spline
mm_interactions()
Test prespecified interactions, and report what the test rests on

Validate

Performance on a stated basis, because apparent, bootstrap-corrected and held-out numbers are not interchangeable.

mm_validate()
Validate the model, on a stated basis

Inspect the fit

The standard generics over a fitted model. Three cannot delegate to rms and the documentation says which, and why.

coef(<mm_model>) vcov(<mm_model>) formula(<mm_model>) nobs(<mm_model>) fitted(<mm_model>) residuals(<mm_model>) confint(<mm_model>) summary(<mm_model>) print(<summary.mm_model>)
Standard accessors for a fitted mysterymodel

Recalibrate

Correcting what a model says about the LEVEL of risk, which is the error a reader of an absolute probability actually meets. A correction is monotone, so it reorders nobody and cannot repair discrimination.

mm_recal_intercept()
Fit an intercept correction on a recalibration sample
mm_recal_slope()
Fit the two-parameter correction, a + b * lp
mm_recal_apply()
Apply a correction to linear predictors
mm_recal_by()
Per-stratum intercept corrections
mm_recal_mi()
Estimate a correction on each imputation and pool it
mm_rubin()
Combine one scalar estimate across imputations by Rubin's rules

Clinical utility

Net benefit across the thresholds a reader might hold. Computing the curve is not authorisation to publish one.

mm_decision_curve()
Net benefit across treatment thresholds

Collinearity

Three questions, because each misses what the others catch. The verdict is per variable; the per-parameter detail is reported beside it, since one spline’s bases are collinear with each other by construction.

mm_collinearity_report()
All three collinearity diagnostics on a fitted model
mm_vif_check()
Variance inflation, per variable and per parameter
mm_redun_check()
Which variables are predictable from the others
mm_cor_pairs()
The strongly correlated numeric pairs, for a human to look at

Present

A nomogram that is checked against the model it was drawn from, and a calculator built from the model’s own prediction schema.

mm_nomogram()
Draw the nomogram, and prove it agrees with the model
mm_calculator()
A calculator for exactly this fitted model

Data

mm_synthetic_cohort()
Generate a synthetic cohort resembling a urodynamics study
